verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an error-tracking SaaS with an API and MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. The ability to create additional accounts is at most a user-side workaround, not a sandbox capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
